wiki.title: Nasif Majeed
wiki.extract: Nasif Rashad Majeed (born September 27, 1945) is an unaffiliated (formerly Democratic) member of the North Carolina House of Representatives. He has represented the 99th district since 2019. He ran for re-election in 2026, but lost in the Democratic primary to Veleria Levy and disaffiliated from the party the following month.
